description: 強震断層モデル(3)液状化データ [earthquakes] is a dataset listed in G-spatial Information Center (G空間情報センター), Japan, an open data portal, published or maintained by 内閣府　日本海溝・千島海溝沿いの巨大地震モデル検討会. 内閣府の日本海溝・千島海溝沿いの巨大地震モデル検討会において検討を行った震度分布・浸水域等に係るデータです。 (３)液状化データ 問い合わせの際には、問い合わせフォームの「ご意見、ご感想」記入欄の冒頭に【液状化データに関する問い合わせ】とご記入ください。 データのダウンロードは、ユーザー登録の後、ログイン状態で行ってください。. Coverage: Japan. The portal files it under the publisher 内閣府　日本海溝・千島海溝沿いの巨大地震モデル検討会. Its tags are 内閣府, 千島海溝, 日本海溝. It offers 4 resource(s) in csv, pdf. The portal shows 2025-08-25 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is GNU Free Documentation License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-gsi-portal.
